description: This file defines the SharedBuffer class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, which facilitates inter-process shared memory communication with semaphore-based synchronization. It includes class declarations, member functions, and internal structures for managing shared buffers, semaphores, and access control.

classes.name: SharedBuffer
classes.description: A class for sharing data over process boundaries using shared memory and semaphores, supporting producer and consumer roles with synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: SharedBuffer::Semaphore
classes.description: A nested class managing semaphore operations for synchronization, with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: SharedBuffer::Administration
classes.description: A structure holding administrative data such as bytes written and semaphores for producer and consumer.

methods.name: SharedBuffer(const TCHAR name[])
methods.description: Constructor for the consumer role, initializing shared buffer with a given name.

methods.name: SharedBuffer(const TCHAR name[], const uint32_t mode, const uint32_t bufferSize, const uint16_t administrationSize)
methods.description: Constructor for the producer role, setting up shared buffer with specified mode, size, and administration area.

methods.name: RequestProduce
methods.description: Requests permission to produce data, locking the producer semaphore.

methods.name: Produced
methods.description: Signals that data production is complete, unlocking the consumer semaphore.

methods.name: RequestConsume
methods.description: Requests permission to consume data, locking the consumer semaphore.

methods.name: Consumed
methods.description: Signals that data has been consumed, unlocking the producer semaphore.

methods.name: AdministrationBuffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the administration buffer.

methods.name: BytesWritten
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes written in the shared buffer.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Gets user permissions for the shared buffer.

methods.name: Group
methods.description: Gets group permissions for the shared buffer.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Gets permission mode for the shared buffer.
